insert.header-footer.page-number.remove-.note: U:quill/rest: Remove Page Numbers takes the PAGE, NUMPAGES and SECTIONPAGES fields out of every header and footer. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

insert.pages.cover-page.remove-current-c.note: U:quill/rest: Remove Current Cover Page takes the first page away when it is a cover page (a Title paragraph on a first page that ends in a page break, as Insert › Cover Page makes it). Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

review.ink.hide-ink.delete-all-ink-in-do.note: U:quill/rest: Delete All Ink in Document removes every ink stroke, hidden or not; other shapes stay. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

review.speech.read-aloud.note: U:quill/rest: Read Aloud speaks the selection, or the text from the caret on, with an offline voice of this computer (the Web Speech API's local voices; nothing is sent anywhere). Off on a computer with no installed voice. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

view.show.hide-white-space.note: U:quill/rest: Hide White Space (Print Layout): where two pages meet, the bottom margin with its footer and the next top margin with its header collapse into a thin divider; the first page keeps its top margin and the last its bottom one. Display only; the pagination does not change. Not checked against upstream (wordcraft's page geometry for it is not translated; follows Word).

view.dark-mode.interface-theme.note: U:quill/rest: Interface Theme (System, Light, Dark): the work area and rulers round the pages follow it; Dark is the default look. Kept in the person's settings, not the document. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

immersive-reader.immersive-reader.line-f.note: U:quill/rest: Line Focus keeps one, three or five lines lit round the caret and dims the rest of the page. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

immersive-reader.immersive-reader.syllab.note: U:quill/rest: Syllables needs the layout to reserve room for a dot between syllables; the layout does not, so it stays hidden.

picture-format.adjust.color.color-tone.note: U:quill/rest: Color Tone: Word's eight temperature presets (4700 K to 11200 K, 6500 K as the picture is) as a white balance of the bitmap, absolute from the original. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

picture-format.adjust.color.set-transpar.note: U:quill/rest: Set Transparent Color: the next click on the picture picks the colour that becomes transparent (the pointer is a crosshair until then). Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-effects.note: U:quill/rest + U:quill/shapes: shadow (the nine offsets), reflection (tight, half, full), glow, soft edges and bevel (the twelve shapes), each with a "No" entry; every selected shape and picture. Reflection and bevel are deckcraft's effects (wordcraft has the other three). Preset is twelve combinations of them (not checked against upstream, follows Word).

picture-format.picture-styles.picture-ef.note: U:quill/rest + U:quill/shapes: shadow (the nine offsets), reflection (tight, half, full), glow, soft edges and bevel (the twelve shapes), each with a "No" entry; every selected shape and picture. Reflection and bevel are deckcraft's effects (wordcraft has the other three). Preset is twelve combinations of them (not checked against upstream, follows Word).

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.pic.note: U:quill/rest: Picture… opens the system Open dialog; the shape, text box or canvas background is filled with the picture, stretched over it (saved as a:blipFill). Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

shape-format.shape-styles.shape-fill.tex.note: U:quill/rest: Texture: the 24 textures named as Word names them, drawn by Arkemis (seamless tiles from seeded noise, not Word's photographs), tiled over the shape and saved as a:blipFill with a:tile. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

table-layout.draw.draw-table.note: U:quill/rest: Draw Table turns the pen on: a dragged rectangle draws a table, a dragged line splits the cells it crosses (table.draw, wordcraft table_draw.rs); click the button again to turn it off.

table-layout.draw.eraser.note: U:quill/rest: Eraser turns the eraser on: a click removes the border under it (table.eraser, wordcraft table_draw.rs); click the button again to turn it off.

table-design.borders.borders.draw-table.note: U:quill/rest: Draw Table, as on Table Layout.

insert.tables.table.draw-table.note: U:quill/rest: Draw Table turns the pen on, as on Table Layout.

table-design.borders.border-styles.note: U:quill/rest: Border Styles holds Border Sampler; the Theme Borders gallery (ready-made border sets) and Recently Used Borders have no engine, and Line Style, Line Weight, Pen Color and the Borders menu do the same by hand.

items.label: Recently Used Borders
items.note: U:quill/rest: Recently Used Borders needs the Border Styles gallery, which has no engine; hidden.

items.label: Border Sampler
items.note: U:quill/rest: Border Sampler: click a border and its line style, weight and colour become the pen of the Borders menu and Border Painter. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

table-design.borders.borders.diagonal-do.note: U:quill/rest: Diagonal Down Border: a line from the top left to the bottom right corner of each selected cell, in the table pen (w:tl2br). Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

table-design.borders.borders.diagonal-up.note: U:quill/rest: Diagonal Up Border: a line from the bottom left to the top right corner of each selected cell, in the table pen (w:tr2bl). Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

home.paragraph.borders.diagonal-down-bor.note: U:quill/rest: Diagonal Down Border, as on Table Design; only in a table.

home.paragraph.borders.diagonal-up-borde.note: U:quill/rest: Diagonal Up Border, as on Table Design; only in a table.

developer.controls.legacy-tools.note: U:quill/rest: Legacy Tools holds the legacy form fields of Word 97-2003 forms (Text Form Field, Check Box Form Field, Drop-Down Form Field, Reset Form Fields); ActiveX controls are Windows code Quill never runs, Insert Frame and Form Field Shading are not offered. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

items.label: ActiveX Controls
items.note: U:quill/developer: ActiveX controls are Windows code Quill never runs; hidden.

review.accessibility.check-accessibility.note: U:quill/rest: Check Accessibility (file.accessibility, wordcraft cmd/accessibility.rs) lists what makes the document hard to use with a screen reader or to read: Errors, Warnings and Tips in the Accessibility pane, each a jump to its place and maybe a fix.

layout.arrange.wrap-text.edit-wrap-point.note: U:quill/rest: Edit Wrap Points shows the outline text follows round a Tight or Through object as a polygon with a handle at each point (drag one to move it, Ctrl-click to delete it, click a side to add one); the first use makes the wrapping Tight with a polygon of the object's own outline. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

layout.arrange.wrap-text.set-as-default-.note: U:quill/rest: Set as Default Layout keeps the selected object's wrapping, text sides and distance in the person's settings; a picture, shape, text box or canvas inserted afterwards starts with it. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

layout.arrange.align.grid-settings.note: U:quill/rest: Grid Settings opens the drawing grid box: the horizontal and vertical spacing and whether the page view draws the gridlines. Snap to grid is not offered. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

picture-format.arrange.wrap-text.edit-wr.note: U:quill/rest: Edit Wrap Points shows the outline text follows round a Tight or Through object as a polygon with a handle at each point (drag one to move it, Ctrl-click to delete it, click a side to add one); the first use makes the wrapping Tight with a polygon of the object's own outline. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

picture-format.arrange.wrap-text.set-as-.note: U:quill/rest: Set as Default Layout keeps the selected object's wrapping, text sides and distance in the person's settings; a picture, shape, text box or canvas inserted afterwards starts with it. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

picture-format.arrange.align.grid-settin.note: U:quill/rest: Grid Settings opens the drawing grid box: the horizontal and vertical spacing and whether the page view draws the gridlines. Snap to grid is not offered. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

shape-format.arrange.wrap-text.edit-wrap.note: U:quill/rest: Edit Wrap Points shows the outline text follows round a Tight or Through object as a polygon with a handle at each point (drag one to move it, Ctrl-click to delete it, click a side to add one); the first use makes the wrapping Tight with a polygon of the object's own outline. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

shape-format.arrange.wrap-text.set-as-de.note: U:quill/rest: Set as Default Layout keeps the selected object's wrapping, text sides and distance in the person's settings; a picture, shape, text box or canvas inserted afterwards starts with it. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

shape-format.arrange.align.grid-settings.note: U:quill/rest: Grid Settings opens the drawing grid box: the horizontal and vertical spacing and whether the page view draws the gridlines. Snap to grid is not offered. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

chart-format.arrange.wrap-text.set-as-de.note: U:quill/rest: Set as Default Layout keeps the selected object's wrapping, text sides and distance in the person's settings; a picture, shape, text box or canvas inserted afterwards starts with it. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

chart-format.arrange.align.grid-settings.note: U:quill/rest: Grid Settings opens the drawing grid box: the horizontal and vertical spacing and whether the page view draws the gridlines. Snap to grid is not offered. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

design.page-background.page-color.fill-e.note: U:quill/rest: Fill Effects opens the box with Gradient, Texture and Pattern; Picture… (next item) picks a picture. The background is made as a bitmap and kept as the page picture (a gradient and a pattern are saved as pictures). Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

home.font.font-color.gradient.note: U:quill/rest: Gradient: Light and Dark Variations are the eight linear gradients of the text's own colour (the tints and shades Shape Fill > Gradient makes), set as the text fill (w14:gradFill); No Gradient takes the fill off. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).

chart-design.data.select-data.note: U:quill/rest: Select Data opens the chart's data grid, the same box as Edit Data (Word picks the data in its embedded sheet; here the grid is that sheet, with Switch Row/Column beside it).

chart-format.arrange.align.distribute-ho.note: U:quill/rest: as Layout > Align > Distribute Horizontally, with the chart among the selected objects.

chart-format.arrange.align.distribute-ve.note: U:quill/rest: as Layout > Align > Distribute Vertically, with the chart among the selected objects.

chart-format.arrange.align.align-to-page.note: U:quill/rest: as Layout > Align > Align to Page.

chart-format.arrange.align.align-to-marg.note: U:quill/rest: as Layout > Align > Align to Margin.

chart-format.arrange.align.align-selecte.note: U:quill/rest: as Layout > Align > Align Selected Objects.

chart-format.arrange.position.more-layou.note: U:quill/rest: More Layout Options opens the Layout box of Picture Format and Shape Format for the chart.

chart-format.arrange.wrap-text.more-layo.note: U:quill/rest: More Layout Options opens the Layout box of Picture Format and Shape Format for the chart.

picture-format.adjust.corrections.pictur.note: U:quill/rest: Picture Corrections Options opens the Format Picture pane on its Picture tab (brightness, contrast, sharpness).

picture-format.adjust.color.picture-colo.note: U:quill/rest: Picture Color Options opens the Format Picture pane on its Picture tab (colour saturation).

dialog.gridSettings.title: Grid Settings
dialog.gridSettings.note: U:quill/rest: the drawing grid: spacing in points and Display gridlines on screen. Not checked against upstream.

dialog.fillEffects.title: Fill Effects
dialog.fillEffects.note: U:quill/rest: the page background as a gradient, a texture or a pattern. Not checked against upstream.

design.page-background.page-color.fill-e.label: Picture…
design.page-background.page-color.fill-e.note: U:quill/rest: Picture… opens the system Open dialog; the picture becomes the page background, stretched over the page. Not checked against upstream (follows Word).
